DNS::authority
Description
This iRules command returns, inserts, removes, or clears RRs from the
authority section.
Note: This command functions only in the context of LTM iRules and
requires the DNS Profile, which is only enabled as part of GTM or the
DNS Services add-on.
Syntax
DNS
::
authority
[[
insert
|
remove
rr_obj
]
|
clear
]
DNS::authority
[[insert|remove rr_obj] | clear]
Returns, inserts, removes, or clears RRs from the authority section.
With no arguments, get tcl list of RR objs; with arg, insert/remove
RR tcl obj in the authority section or clear all RRs from the
authority section.
Examples
Related Information
Valid Events:
DNS_REQUEST
